GUIDE: Utilizing PWA installation

Progressive Web Applications, PWA, are web applications and desktop applications made available by having one code base. Pwas are becoming more common as HTML5 integrates more and more. Take advantage of pwa on your PC with Edge browser option Install as an App

Install As An App:

Step 1: Open settings --> Apps

Step 2: Click Install this site as an app

Setting's Apps option is only available if the web application is a pwa.1

Step 3 (Options): Configure shortcut location(s) and/or launch behavior.

❮ ❯

Review: That's it! Now you have the website as an desktop application.

  • Launch the application standalone
  • Sign-in is the same as in a browser
  • Experience is the same as in a browser
